chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Faddal, from Abu Jamila, from Jabir, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said:

The Messenger of God (may God bless him and his family) said: 'Whoever maintains ties with a relative through a hajj or an umrah, God will record for him two hajjs and two umrahs. And similarly, whoever bears a burden on behalf of a close friend, God will multiply his reward twofold.'

key_terms.حَجَّة / عُمْرَة: Hajj (major pilgrimage) / Umrah (minor pilgrimage); both are acts of worship involving travel to Mecca
key_terms.حَمِيم: A close, dear friend or intimate companion; used to indicate affectionate closeness
key_terms.وَصَلَ قَرِيباً: Maintaining ties with a relative (silat al-rahim); a highly meritorious act in Islamic ethics
key_terms.يُضَاعِفُ الْأَجْرَ ضِعْفَيْنِ: God will multiply the reward twofold; a divine promise of doubled recompense

ai.seo_question: What reward does Islam promise for performing hajj or umrah while maintaining family ties?
ai.summary: Imam al-Baqir (peace be upon him) reports that the Prophet Muhammad (SAWW) declared special spiritual rewards for those who combine acts of worship — hajj or umrah — with the maintenance of family ties. The hadith further extends this principle to bearing burdens on behalf of close friends, promising doubled rewards in both cases. This teaching was directed at a community where pilgrimage was one of the highest acts of worship, encouraging believers to use such sacred journeys as occasions for strengthening kinship bonds.

en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Fazzal, from Abu Jameela, from Jabir, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘The one who maintains good relationship with relatives by a Hajj or an Umrah, Allah<sup>azwj</sup> would Write for him two Hajj and to Umrahs, and similar to that is the one who carries (a burden) from a friend, Allah<sup>azwj</sup> would Increase the Recompense for him by double’.
en.sarwar: 1. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from ibn Faddal from abu Jamilah from Jabir who has said the following: “Abu Ja’far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has stated the following Hadith. ‘

The Messenger of Allah, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, has said, “For one who helps a relative to perform Hajj or ‘Umrah, Allah writes it as though it was two Hajj and two ‘Umrah. Likewise is the case when a friend helps his friend, that is, Allah doubles his reward.’””
